summary: DoRaa Sangam House is a luxury-themed e-commerce SPA (React + TypeScript, Tailwind + shadcn/ui) for browsing and purchasing premium Banarasi sarees. It includes a storefront (catalog browsing, wishlist, cart, Razorpay test-mode checkout, user dashboard) and a separate admin panel (Internet Identity + RBAC) to manage a canister-backed product catalog on the Internet Computer (Motoko). The app also implements SEO/pwa/performance polish: shareable product URLs with dynamic metadata, sitemap/robots, image lazy-loading, route code-splitting, and offline app-shell caching via a service worker.

architectural_notes: Custom lightweight SPA routing via History API (useSpaLocation) instead of React Router.
TanStack React Query used for backend actor lifecycle, data fetching (products/orders), and cache invalidation on mutations/logout.
Client state split into Context providers (CommerceProvider for cart; AdminProductsProvider for admin catalog) with localStorage/sessionStorage persistence helpers.
Hybrid auth model: storefront OTP session (simulated + WebOTP helper) and/or Internet Identity; canister calls use Internet Identity and RBAC initialization via a secret token.
Backend is a Motoko canister with modular RBAC (AccessControl + MixinAuthorization), plus product catalog and order/profile storage in stable actor state.
Mapping layer converts AdminProduct form data into backend Product (variants from colors×sizes, bigint/Nat conversions).
PWA support uses static public assets (manifest.json, sw.js) and runtime registration from App.tsx; service worker avoids caching IC canister API calls.
Performance/UX emphasizes loading skeletons, lazy-loaded images, and code-splitting (lazy admin routes and product detail route).
Extensive motion/ambient visuals (canvas backgrounds, hero slider) are built to respect prefers-reduced-motion and reduce re-renders using refs.

Implement a minimal, reusable error-toast utility (top-right, 4s auto-dismiss) that can be invoked from existing OTP/profile-save/network error handlers without changing routing/auth flow or adding heavy new systems.
known_issues: Admin access is gated by a hardcoded principal (ADMIN_PRINCIPAL = "2vxsx-fae", the anonymous principal), which effectively blocks real admins unless reconfigured.
RBAC initialization traps if the canister env var CAFFEINE_ADMIN_TOKEN is not set; deployments without it will fail when initializing access control.
AccessControl.getUserRole traps for unregistered principals; callers must have run _initializeAccessControlWithSecret before invoking role-protected methods.
backend/order.mo uses a fixed timestamp constant (1712411343000), so order dates are incorrect.
getUserOrdersByYearMonth compares timestamps against a YYYYMMDD-like numeric range, so filtering logic is incorrect for real epoch timestamps.
CommerceProvider computes cartTotal from localStorage key "doraa-admin-products"; the authoritative product catalog is now canister-backed, so totals can be wrong unless localStorage is kept in sync.
Storefront product conversion assigns random rating/reviewCount on each fetch, causing inconsistent UX metrics across refreshes.
AdminProductsProvider.createProduct awaits refresh but then looks up the new product in a stale closure of `products`, which can fail to find the created product.
ZIP CSV extraction is a simplified implementation that assumes uncompressed ZIP entries; many real ZIP files will fail to parse.
Some placeholders are incomplete/empty: useRegisterUser mutation is a no-op; several files are empty stubs (e.g., SangamBackground.tsx, dummyProducts.ts, banarasiGrouping.ts).
